items.label: 3-Piece Bistro Set
items.value: This outdoor wicker bistro set includes two comfy armchairs with cushions and pillows, and a round table for drinks, snacks, or decor, ideal for gardens, patios, or poolside relaxation

items.label: Durable Build
items.value: Built on a powder-coated metal frame, each chair supports up to 300 lb. The PE plastic combines flexibility and elegance, ensuring long-term durability and style of the conversation set

items.label: Tempered Glass Top
items.value: The round table has a tempered glass surface that’s stronger and more scratch-resistant than regular glass, and the built-in suction cups ensure the glass stays securely in place

items.label: Versatile Arrangement
items.value: Each piece in the three-piece bistro set is lightweight and simple to move, so you can easily transport them to any outdoor space and use them together or separately as needed

items.label: Comfortable Seating
items.value: Cushions and pillows in this bistro set filled with soft foam provide optimal comfort. The removable, washable covers make cleaning a breeze, while polyester ensures long-lasting durability

items.label: Material
items.value: PE, Steel, Polyester, Foam, Tempered Glass

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: No assembly required, ready to use out of the box.
